news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Jaylen Wright (quad) good to go for Week 10
news.desc: Jaylen Wright (quad) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
news.impact: Wright is going to be good to go for Sunday's game. He was able to practice in full all week, so his quad issue is nothing serious at this point. He isn't expected to be fantasy relevant moving forward, however.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Zaire Franklin (shin) doubtful to play Sunday
news.desc: Zaire Franklin (shin) is doubtful to play in Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
news.impact: Franklin has been out for multiple weeks due to a shin issue, and it looks like he's going to be sidelined for yet another game on Sunday, as he's currently considered doubtful to play. The team has their bye week coming up in Week 11, however, so it seems likely that he will be good to go after that.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Chris Brooks (ankle) listed questionable for Sunday
news.desc: Chris Brooks (ankle) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
news.impact: Brooks has been out for multiple weeks while recovering from an ankle issue, but his return to the lineup may come on Sunday, as he is officially considered questionable to play against the Vikings. If he's active, he may actually see a solid amount of opportunities with Josh Jacobs (finger) set to be sidelined for this game.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Micah Parsons (knee) won't play Sunday
news.desc: Micah Parsons (knee) won't play in Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
news.impact: Parsons isn't quite ready to make his return to the lineup and will be sidelined for another game on Sunday. He will likely be ready to go after the team's bye in Week 11, so their defensive front will have to continue to make due without him in the meantime.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Skyy Moore (ankle) considered questionable for Sunday
news.desc: Skyy Moore (ankle) is considered questionable for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
news.impact: Moore has been sidelined by an ankle injury for close to a month, but he is questionable and will have a chance to make his return to the lineup on Sunday. His availability won't have a big impact for fantasy purposes either way, however.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Josh Whyle (concussion) unavailable for Sunday
news.desc: Josh Whyle (concussion) will be unavailable for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
news.impact: Whyle is still going through the NFL's concussion protocols and will be unavailable to play on Sunday as a result. His absence isn't expected to have a big impact from a fantasy perspective, however.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Javon Bullard (ankle/knee) listed questionable for Sunday
news.desc: Javon Bullard (ankle/knee) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
news.impact: Bullard may be ruled out for Sunday's game, as he is currently considered questionable to play due to two injuries he's nursing. His absence would make life easier for Kirk Cousins and Co. on the other side of the ball.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Sean Rhyan (ankle) sidelined for Sunday
news.desc: Sean Rhyan (ankle) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
news.impact: The Packers are set to be without their starting center in Week 10. Rhyan has been ruled out with an ankle issue, and it's unclear if it will cause him to miss more time beyond this game or not. Green Bay's offensive front will be weaker than usual while he's out.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Lukas Van Ness (back) questionable for Sunday
news.desc: Lukas Van Ness (back) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
news.impact: Van Ness was able to make his return to practice on Friday but is still considered questionable to play heading into the weekend. His status will likely depend on how his back feels closer to game time on Sunday.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Josh Jacobs (finger) officially ruled out for Sunday
news.desc: Josh Jacobs (finger) has officially been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
news.impact: As expected, Jacobs has officially been ruled out after undergoing a procedure to address a finger injury he suffered last week. There's a real chance that he will miss more time beyond this game, so fantasy managers should expect more work for Kaleb Johnson and MarShawn Lloyd for the foreseeable future.
